_readme: Question bank for the Estimate game: economics and finance, from textbook theory to real-world numbers.
Fields: id (unique, never reuse), category (theory | corpfin | markets | macro | companies | history | czsk | fermi), difficulty (easy | medium | hard),
question {en, cs, sk}, answer (a plain positive number), unit {en, cs, sk} (empty for years and plain ratios),
source {name, url} ('Calculation: ...' for worked-out answers), year (the year the figure applies to, or null).
Optional: format: 'year' for 'In what year...' questions (no thousands separators, scored by span in years);
verify: a note on anything that should be double-checked before relying on it.
